title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #6

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   D. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   B. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   C. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   B. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   C. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Positive Usage of Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibition in Islam 02 5.3.1 Dua 02 6.0 Muamalat 6.1 Obligation of parents to c and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam: Evils of Begging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dua 02 6.0 Muamalat 6.1 Obligation of parents to children 03 6.2 Obligation of c and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. B — Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Positive Usage of Media; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibition in Islam 02 5.3.1 Dua 02 6.0 Muamalat 6.1 Obligation of parents to c; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam: Evils of Begging; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dua 02 6.0 Muamalat 6.1 Obligation of parents to children 03 6.2 Obligation of c; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
